title: Editor crashed when moving multiple pasted nodes after changing the target(parent) node‘s type
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], master f5918a9d3.

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev (f5918a9d3) - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745H w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 25.22 GiB memory

### Issue description

This appears to be a duplicate of #25211. 

After copying the nodes, before pasting and moving them, performing a **Change Type** on the parent node to which the nodes are to be pasted seems to be the key to reproducing this issue.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Copy multiple nodes from a scene;
2. Go to the target scene where you want to paste them and perform a **Change Type** operation on the parent node (target node);
3. Paste the nodes;
4. Move the newly pasted nodes.
